paths.name: Plane Takeoff
paths.description: Ground roll accelerating down the runway, rotate, then climb out to altitude.

paths.name: Plane Landing
paths.description: Descend on approach from the current altitude, touch down, and roll out to a full stop.

paths.name: Plane Flyby
paths.description: A fast, level pass at the current altitude — clamps up to a safe minimum if started low.

paths.name: Plane Banked Circle
paths.description: One full banked circle at altitude, curving back to finish near where it started.

paths.name: Plane Crash Dive
paths.description: A steep dive from altitude down to ground contact, then a short skid to a stop.

paths.name: Helicopter Takeoff
paths.description: A vertical lift-off to ~12m with a slight forward drift as it climbs.

paths.name: Helicopter Landing
paths.description: Descend from the current altitude, settle onto the ground, and spin down to a stop.

paths.name: Helicopter Orbit
paths.description: Circle a point of interest at the current altitude — the classic circling news chopper.

paths.name: Helicopter Hover Hold
paths.description: Hold position with a tiny drift as the rotors keep spinning — a hovering standby.

paths.name: Bird Circle Soar
paths.description: Lazy circles on a thermal, drifting gently upward — a hawk riding the air.

paths.name: Bird Swoop
paths.description: A dive toward the ground ahead, a low skim, then a climb back up — a hunting stoop.

paths.name: Bird Flock Pass
paths.description: A fast, gently-waving S-path across the frame — a flock cutting through the air.

paths.name: Car Chase Weave
paths.description: A fast run forward with hard S-weaves — dodging through traffic in a chase.

paths.name: Car Drift Turn
paths.description: A fast approach into a sharp 90° turn on a wide drifting arc.

paths.name: Car Screech Stop
paths.description: A fast approach into a hard braking stop — tires screech, car parks dead.

paths.name: Car Pull-Up & Park
paths.description: A moderate approach curving to the side and easing to a parked stop at the curb.

paths.name: Car Reverse Escape
paths.description: A beat of stillness, then reverse hard and swing 180° into a getaway J-turn.

paths.name: Motorcycle Weave
paths.description: A fast run forward with tight, quick S-weaves — a bike threading between traffic.

paths.name: Boat Wake Turn
paths.description: A fast run forward carving into a wide banked turn, throwing a long wake — still moving at the end.

paths.name: Train Pass-Through
paths.description: A long, steady, straight high-speed pass along the heading — a train roaring through frame.

paths.name: Car Jump Ramp
paths.description: Approach, launch off a ramp into a ballistic arc peaking a few metres up, land and roll to a settle.

paths.name: Truck Jackknife Stop
paths.description: A fast approach into a hard braking stop that swings the tail out to one side, then parks.

paths.name: Debris Fall
paths.description: A chunk falls with a slight outward arc, bounces once, and settles on the ground.

paths.name: Building Topple
paths.description: A wall or column leans out, accelerates, and crashes down along an arc to the ground.

paths.name: Object Thrown Arc
paths.description: A ballistic arc forward, peaking above the start, landing with a small bounce to a stop.

paths.name: Object Tornado Spiral
paths.description: A rising, expanding spiral — papers or debris caught and lofted by a whirlwind.

paths.name: Walk Forward
paths.description: A steady walk straight ahead along the heading at ~1.4 m/s.

paths.name: Run Forward
paths.description: A fast run straight ahead along the heading at ~5 m/s.

paths.name: Walk Up Stairs
paths.description: Climbs a staircase: eight even steps up ~1.4m of rise over ~6m forward, then a level hold at the top.

paths.name: Jump Forward
paths.description: Three forward hops — each arcs up ~0.5m while advancing ~1.2m.

paths.name: Door Burst Run
paths.description: Explode forward from a standstill — a brief still beat, then accelerate hard into a full run.

paths.name: Horse Gallop Loop
paths.description: A galloping travel around a large oval that returns near its start — a loop-friendly run.

paths.name: Dog Fetch Run
paths.description: Run out forward, pause to grab the ball, then run back — ending near where it started.
